def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # A 5-line is an axis: copy the attached multicolor tile along the axis.
    for c in range(w):
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==5]
        if len(rows)<2: continue
        lo,hi=min(rows),max(rows)
        # Find a rectangular nonzero tile directly to either side of the axis,
        # attached near one end; repeat its row pattern along the axis.
        for side in (-1,1):
            start=c+side
            if not 0<=start<w: continue
            for r in range(lo,hi+1):
                if g[r][start]!=0 and g[r][start]!=5: break
            else: continue
            # contiguous colored rectangle at start, anchored at r
            r0=r
            cols=[]; x=start
            while 0<=x<w and g[r0][x] not in (0,5): cols.append(x); x+=side
            # seek vertical extent of tile by contiguous nonzero cells in those columns
            top=r0
            while top-1>=0 and all(g[top-1][x]!=0 and g[top-1][x]!=5 for x in cols): top-=1
            bot=r0
            while bot+1<h and all(g[bot+1][x]!=0 and g[bot+1][x]!=5 for x in cols): bot+=1
            tile=[[g[y][x] for x in cols] for y in range(top,bot+1)]
            for y in range(lo,hi+1):
                if y<top or y>bot:
                    pattern=tile[(y-top)%len(tile)]
                    for x,v in zip(cols,pattern): g[y][x]=v
            return g
    return g
